name: Driving
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of wisdom, understanding, and focused attention, as seen in Proverbs' call to keep one's eyes straight ahead and heed instruction. The fear of the LORD is foundational for gaining true wisdom and good understanding, which leads to success in following His commandments. Regarding the dangers of impaired judgment, Proverbs warns that wine and strong drink deceive and are marks of folly, a caution especially relevant to the topic of drinking and driving. Ultimately, those who love the LORD reject evil and are preserved from harm, underscoring the need for godly discernment and self-control in all actions, including driving.
